title: Construct Quick-Select (3 Presets)
description: Implements a radial quick-select on the non-dominant controller to spawn one of three constructs: Shield, Hammer, Platform. While holding the assignable menu button, display a simple radial selector with three slices. On selection release, spawn the chosen construct prefab at a context-appropriate position: Shield snaps to ground in front of player, Hammer spawns grabbable in front of player hands with two-hand grab hints, Platform spawns slightly ahead at ground/hover height. Each construct has a timed despawn (e.g., 30s) or can be dismissed by the player. Ensure constructs use green emissive materials but rely on provided prefabs. Integrate with physics where applicable (hammer), and block projectiles for shield. Provide JSON-configurable prefab/entity template ids for each construct, per-scene altitude clamp for platform placement, and lifetime seconds. Support haptic pulse on spawn and brief cooldown to prevent spam.
acceptance_notes: Holding the radial menu button on the non-dominant controller should present three clear options. Releasing while pointing at an option spawns the corresponding construct. Platform persists ~30s and is standable; Shield blocks projectiles; Hammer is grabbable with strong impact feedback. Despawn occurs on timer or dismiss; spamming is rate-limited.
